column1: # What a feature proof (scripts/proof.sh --tier feature) runs for each changed
# path — AGENTS.md §11.2. Read by test/tools/proofrun; the FIRST matching row
# wins, so a narrow row sits above the broad row it carves out of.
# The table FAILS CLOSED: a changed path no row matches refuses the feature
# tier ("unmapped path"), and a row whose action is `full` refuses it too,
# because that path changes how every suite runs. Both mean: run make proof.
# Columns are TAB-separated: pattern, actions (comma-separated), flags.
#   pattern   a path glob: `**` spans directories, `*` and `?` stay inside one;
#             a pattern with no slash matches a base name at any depth.
#   actions   go             the Go rule for the file's package (§4.2 of the design)
#             proto          the UI type-check and unit suites (gen/ changes carry the Go rule)
#             ui             UI source: type-check, unit, and it needs an evidence spec
#             spec           a Playwright spec: run it
#             ui-unit        a UI unit test file
#             all-specs      the Playwright harness: run every spec
#             images         the activity contract fixture, and the Go rule for internal/orker
#             examples       the tests and specs that read the changed example
#             tool           the tests and specs that run the changed test/tools tool
#             site           the site gate (bun run check && bun run build in site/); it is
#                            the whole evidence for a path that only the site reads, and a
#                            row names it beside the actions the path already has
#             none           nothing to prove (the unit gate still runs)
#   flags     temporal       the package is Temporal- or storage-facing: its
#                            evidence must include an integration test
# site/ is a Bun project that renders the repository's markdown (docs/**, every
# from proto/**), and takes its whole style from ui/src/tokens.css. Its one
# check, `bun run check && bun run build`, is the site gate. This row sits
# above the documentation rows below so that **.md and .gitignore, which
# match at any depth, never shadow a file of site/ and leave it unproven.
# Below, a row for a path the site reads carries `site` beside the actions it
# already had, so a change to it runs the site gate and nothing else changes.
# ---- documentation: nothing to prove but the site's build ------------------
# The unit gate's config-completeness tests cover the generated defaults; the
# site renders them as the configuration reference.
# ---- how every suite runs: refuse the feature tier -------------------------
# The quickstart: every image it builds and the stack every user starts.
# Measurements: they change which tests a feature proof defers and the order
# a full proof runs them in, never what a full proof runs.
# The runner-health floors: a feature proof may re-derive them; a floor only
# ever turns a part into "not a proof of the tree", never into a pass.
# The site renders docs/API.md, which is generated from proto/**.
# The Playwright harness, its config and the UI's dependencies: every spec.
# The site installs the UI's fonts at the UI's versions (its drift check reads
# ui/package.json) and imports the UI's icons (ui/src/lib/icons.ts); tokens.css
# is its whole style. Each keeps the UI action it always had.
